params.prompt: Consideration is the value exchanged for the contractual promise. The applicant supplies the premium and application statements; the insurer supplies its promise to pay according to the contract. Competent parties must have the legal capacity to contract. A lawful purpose means the arrangement cannot be built around an illegal objective. Life insurance on another person also raises insurable-interest and consent requirements. These ideas are related but different. A perfectly completed form cannot make an illegal betting arrangement valid merely because someone paid a premium.

reason: Both ASR models rendered wagering as waging; rephrased as illegal betting for clarity.
